Daehwa Pharmaceutical
is a South Korean drug maker known for oncology pipelines (like oral paclitaxel), whereas
the major South Korean pharmaceutical company actively launching a wearable ECG and remote patient monitoring system
is
Daewoong Pharmaceutical
Daewoong Pharmaceutical co-developed and distributes
thynC
, an AI-powered
remote patient monitoring
system utilizing wearable biosensors to track vital signs.
Overview of Daewoong's thynC System
Wearable ECG & Vitals:
Uses skin-attached biosensor patches to continuously measure electrocardiogram (ECG) data, body temperature, and oxygen saturation.
Smart Ward Integration:
Deployed in general hospital beds to stream real-time data to nursing dashboards, aiming to catch critical warning signs (like arrhythmias or patient falls) outside the ICU.
Seoul Economic Daily
AI Analytics:
Employs algorithms to process continuous telemetry and minimize false alarms.
